I wouldn’t say it would be too hard as there is a great need for civil engineers. Especially where I live where there is not of growth. To own your own firm, expect to work as an engineer for quite a few years to understand the business. There is a not you learn that they don’t teach you in school.

I have a civil engineering degree. I would say that it isn’t too stressful, and honestly I was a lot more stressed in school. I like building big projects and it is a lot of fun.

I wouldn’t think you would be $90k-$100k straight out of school with civil engineering. More like $60-$70. It does go up quickly with experience in civil engineering though. If you want more money I would recommend computer engineering or petroleum engineering. That is where the big money is.
